transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

For the last few weeks I’ve just been on this intense high, like I’m wired all the time and can’t turn it off, and it’s starting to scare people at work. It got to the point where my manager and a coworker convinced me I needed to come here and get evaluated.
Have you recently started taking any new medications, over-the-counter supplements, or recreational substances like stimulants?
No, I haven't started any new medications, supplements, or recreational drugs. I've just been drinking a ton of coffee to keep going, but nothing else.
Have you ever had periods in the past where you felt very depressed, down, or low on energy, or have you experienced similar highs before this?

Yeah, I've definitely had some low moods and even some revved-up, high-energy phases earlier in my life. But during those past episodes, I never heard any voices or felt so disconnected from reality like I have during this current high. This is the first time it's gotten this intense.
During those past periods of low moods or high-energy phases, how long did they typically last, and did they affect your ability to work or manage daily life?

This current heavy, hopeless low has been hanging over me for about three months, while the intense high-energy phase has been going on for the last few weeks. It's completely disrupted my life—I've been pulled from my project, HR got involved because of my behavior, and I'm letting basic things like bills, laundry, and seeing friends completely slide.
Are you currently feeling both the hopeless, low mood and the wired, high-energy feelings at the same time, or has the low mood completely gone away since the high-energy phase started?

No, they don't really happen at the same time. When the intense, wired buzz finally dies down, I crash hard into this heavy, hopeless, gray low mood. That heavy crash has been hanging over me for about three months now, following those intense high periods.
You mentioned hearing voices and feeling disconnected from reality during this current high. Could you tell me more about what those voices are saying and what that disconnect feels like?

When I'm working late, I hear a deep male voice just behind my left ear saying, "You were chosen for this," which turns harsh and says, "If you screw this up, everyone will be better off without you" when I doubt myself. I know that's not how sound actually works, and this disconnect only ever happens when I'm in these intense, revved-up states.
Have you ever heard these voices or had other unusual experiences during times when your mood was completely normal and stable for at least two weeks?

No, I've never heard those voices or had any experiences like that when my mood was stable or normal. The voice only started during this recent, intense high-energy period. I've never experienced anything like it when I was feeling balanced or even during past low moods.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with a current manic episode characterized by an intense high, increased energy, and severe functional impairment (work disruption, HR involvement) lasting several weeks. This episode is accompanied by auditory hallucinations (hearing a voice saying 'You were chosen for this') and feelings of unreality, which occur exclusively during these high-energy states. The history of a distinct 3-month depressive episode and past mood swings, combined with the absence of psychotic symptoms during stable mood periods, confirms a diagnosis of Bipolar Affective Disorder, current episode manic with psychotic symptoms (F31.2).
